---
title: "OS non-proportional hazards — computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This is a computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5
imputations), not a replacement for the primary OS model. It uses fixed
imputations 1–5 and 200 posterior standardized survival draws per imputation.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))
runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config, supporting = TRUE)
if (!identical(indices, 1:5)) stop("Supporting OS non-PH analysis requires exactly imputations 1:5.")
data_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations")
output_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "supporting", "os-non-proportional-hazards"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "imputation.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"),
  here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"), knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-supporting-os-nph
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  model_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  draws_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(data_path)) stop("Missing fixed OS imputation ", index, ".")
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("supporting-os-nph-%02d", index),
    input_paths = data_path,
    output_paths = c(model_path, draws_path),
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(label = "computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)",
                   imputation = index, imputations = 1:5, posterior_draws = 200L),
    worker = function() {
      data <- module_read_parquet(data_path)
      data$mgps <- factor(data$mgps, levels = 0:2)
      formula <- survival::Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
        tx + tx:splines::ns(survival_time_days, df = 3) + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps
      model <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
        formula = formula,
        data = data,
        chains = 4L,
        iter = 1000L,
        warmup = 500L,
        cores = 4L,
        basehaz = "ms",
        basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index)
      )
      standardized_curve <- function(treatment, seed) {
        newdata <- data
        newdata$tx <- treatment
        old_exists <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
        old_seed <- if (old_exists) get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
        set.seed(seed)
        raw <- tryCatch(
          rstanarm::posterior_survfit(
            model,
            newdata = newdata,
            times = 0,
            extrapolate = TRUE,
            standardise = TRUE,
            control = list(edist = 182, epoints = 200L),
            return_matrix = TRUE,
            draws = 200L
          ),
          finally = {
            if (old_exists) assign(".Random.seed", old_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
            else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
              rm(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
            }
          }
        )
        matrix_value <- if (is.matrix(raw)) raw else {
          if (!is.list(raw) || length(raw) == 0L) stop("posterior_survfit returned no standardized curves.")
          do.call(cbind, raw)
        }
        matrix_value <- as.matrix(matrix_value)
        times <- attr(raw, "times")
        if (is.null(times) && is.list(raw)) times <- attr(raw[[1L]], "times")
        if (is.null(times)) times <- seq(0, 182, length.out = ncol(matrix_value))
        times <- as.numeric(times)
        if (length(times) != ncol(matrix_value)) stop("Standardized survival times do not match posterior draws.")
        if (nrow(matrix_value) < 200L && ncol(matrix_value) == 200L) matrix_value <- t(matrix_value)
        if (nrow(matrix_value) < 200L) stop("posterior_survfit returned fewer than 200 draws.")
        matrix_value <- matrix_value[seq_len(200L), , drop = FALSE]
        data.frame(
          draw = rep(seq_len(200L), each = length(times)),
          time = rep(times, times = 200L),
          survival = as.vector(t(matrix_value)),
          tx = treatment,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
      curves <- rbind(
        standardized_curve(0, analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 0L)),
        standardized_curve(1, analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 1000L))
      )
      curves$imputation <- index
      module_save_rds(model, model_path)
      module_save_parquet(curves, draws_path)
    }
  )
}
```
